title: Identity Agent Template Schema
description: Configuration schema for the ERC-8004 identity-enabled agent template

AGENT_NAME.description: Agent name (set automatically from project directory name)

AGENT_VERSION.description: Semantic version number for the agent

AGENT_DOMAIN.description: Domain that will host the agent (used for ERC-8004 registration)

AGENT_SHORT_DESCRIPTION.description: Concise marketing sentence for manifests and backend payloads

AGENT_SERVICE_TYPE.description: Service type communicated to the backend

AGENT_TOKEN_NAME.description: Token name to create on the backend factory

AGENT_TOKEN_SYMBOL.description: Ticker symbol (<=10 chars) for the service token

AGENT_BACKEND_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the x402 backend (e.g. http://localhost:3000/api)

AGENT_ACCESS_DETAILS.description: Optional instructions for accessing the service

PAYMENTS_FACILITATOR_URL.description: x402 facilitator endpoint URL for payment processing

PAYMENTS_RECEIVABLE_ADDRESS.description: Payment address - Ethereum (0x...) or Solana (Base58) format depending on network. Separate from AGENT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY which is used for ERC-8004 registration.

PAYMENTS_DEFAULT_PRICE.description: Default price (in micro USDC) applied when entrypoints omit explicit pricing

RPC_URL.description: Blockchain RPC endpoint URL for on-chain operations

IDENTITY_AUTO_REGISTER.description: Auto-register agent on ERC-8004 identity registry at startup

AGENT_METADATA_URI.description: URI where ERC-8004 metadata will be hosted

AGENT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Wallet private key for identity operations (leave blank to auto-generate)

DEVELOPER_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional developer wallet for deployments or advanced flows

notes: Leave AGENT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY empty to let the CLI generate a new wallet automatically. Ensure the wallet (generated or provided) has gas on the selected network.
